clips.caption:
A machine built to generate random 1s and 0s should land at 50/50 every time, no matter who is watching.

Researchers asked someone to sit and simply focus on willing more 1s to appear. The split shifted to 51, sometimes 52 percent, and it happened every time they repeated the test.

Kevin Trudeau calls this the zero-point field: a focused mind sending out a real, measurable signal that machines pick up on.

If a machine with no feelings bends toward a thought, what is your own focus doing to your week right now?

#kevintrudeau #thelawofattraction #mindpower #manifestation #luck #success

Kevin Trudeau was a kid at a Boy Scout banquet, three prizes sitting on the table for a raffle.

He decided to test something he had just read: picking an outcome in his mind and broadcasting it, over and over, before a single name was drawn.

The first name called was not his. Neither was the second. Then the third prize was announced, and it was his name.

The win mattered less than what it proved: the outcome stopped feeling random once he decided it in advance.

Have you ever called something before it happened, then brushed it off as coincidence?
